description: Manage Ticket Tailor events, orders, tickets, and related records.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Ticket Tailor API key used as the HTTP Basic Auth username. Generate a key under Box office settings > API: https://help.tickettailor.com/en/articles/4593218-how-do-i-connect-to-the-ticket-tailor-api

actions.name: get_event
actions.description: Retrieve one event belonging to the connected Ticket Tailor box office.

event_id.description: The Ticket Tailor event ID to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: The Ticket Tailor resource lookup parameters.

object.description: The Ticket Tailor resource type when returned by the API.

outputSchema.description: A Ticket Tailor resource returned by the API.

actions.name: get_issued_ticket
actions.description: Retrieve one issued ticket from the connected Ticket Tailor box office.

issued_ticket_id.description: The Ticket Tailor issued ticket ID to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: The Ticket Tailor resource lookup parameters.

object.description: The Ticket Tailor resource type when returned by the API.

outputSchema.description: A Ticket Tailor resource returned by the API.

actions.name: get_order

inputSchema.description: The Ticket Tailor resource lookup parameters.

object.description: The Ticket Tailor resource type when returned by the API.

actions.name: list_events
actions.description: List events belonging to the connected Ticket Tailor box office.

starting_after.description: A Ticket Tailor object ID used as a cursor for pagination.

ending_before.description: A Ticket Tailor object ID used as a cursor for pagination.

limit.description: The maximum number of resources to return.

start_at.description: Filter events starting at this Unix timestamp.

start_at.gt.description: Filter events starting after this Unix timestamp.

start_at.gte.description: Filter events starting at or after this Unix timestamp.

start_at.lt.description: Filter events starting before this Unix timestamp.

start_at.lte.description: Filter events starting at or before this Unix timestamp.

end_at.description: Filter events ending at this Unix timestamp.

end_at.gt.description: Filter events ending after this Unix timestamp.

end_at.gte.description: Filter events ending at or after this Unix timestamp.

end_at.lt.description: Filter events ending before this Unix timestamp.

end_at.lte.description: Filter events ending at or before this Unix timestamp.

status.description: A comma-separated list of event statuses: published, draft, or sales_closed.

items.description: A Ticket Tailor resource returned by the API.

anyOf.description: The URL for the previous page when one exists.

previous.description: The URL for the previous page when one exists.

links.description: Pagination links returned by Ticket Tailor.
